brief:
Today, 23 October, is Legs B. Nothing has been logged since Legs A on 14 October, nine days ago, so this is the same review and the same Legs B numbers as 16 to 22 October. Last week (12 to 18 October) logged three sessions: Push B, Pull B and Legs A. Legs B has not been trained since 5 October and Push A since 6 October. If you trained on any day from 15 to 22 October and it has not synced, open the app so it uploads; I can only read what has arrived.

What I read from Legs A on 14 October at Chennai: 11 of 20 sets. You did a smith squat in the leg press slot (45 kg for 5, 7, 8), a kettlebell hip thrust in the leg curl slot (20 kg for 8, 12, 12), and split squats at 20 lb for 8 and 10. The leg extension, both hip machines and the calf press were not logged, and there is no note saying why. Still one question, in a note when you can: does the Chennai gym have a leg press, a leg curl, a leg extension and the hip machines? If not, the program gets fitted to the gym you are in. The cable crunch sets were typed in on the evening of 15 October, all three within two seconds, so I treat them as remembered and do not raise off them.

The program did not change today (still version 3). Nothing new has been logged to argue against it. This is the last week of the build block; the deload starts 26 October, three days from today, and that is where the over-full muscles get re-sized. Even training every day, no Legs A fits before then (it would fall on 26 October), so tonight is the last calf press of this block, and unless you tell me Chennai has a leg extension, the deload swaps that slot for a quad lift the gym has. The smith row on Pull B is also swapped at the deload, for a chest-supported or cable row: no Pull B fits before then to test it again. Your last training was nine days ago, which costs no strength, but every Legs B lift was last done on 5 October at Singapore, 18 days ago, on different machines; the Chennai numbers below are starting points, and where a machine is new to you the first set finds the weight.

Tonight, in this order. Smith RDL: 70 kg for 8 to warm in, then 80 kg twice, aiming for 10 each time; if 80 is light, use the last set to find the real weight and log it. The test for keeping the RDL is 10 at 80 kg, which is why the card asks for 10. Smith squat: 40 kg for 8 to warm in, then 45 kg aiming for 8 on both sets, the same machine as 14 October; that night it came first and went 5, 7, 8, tonight it comes after the RDLs. Leg press, feet high: 150, 170, 190 lb for 10 (about 68, 77, 86 kg if the stack is in kilos), a starting point on a new machine; if there is no leg press, do the kettlebell hip thrust at 20 kg for 12s instead and mark it on the card. Leg curl: 120 lb (about 54 kg) for 10 to 12; if there is no machine, a dumbbell leg curl lying face down on a bench, marked on the card. Hanging leg raise 12 and 12. Cable crunch: the first set finds the stack, about 25 kg for 12, then 27.5 kg for 10 twice if that was easy. Calf press last: 270 lb (about 122 kg) to find the machine, then 290 lb (about 132 kg) for 12 twice; if there is no machine, any standing calf raise, logged as what it was.

If you do Push B tonight instead, every slot on the card carries my numbers, including bench dips at 17 for three sets, the lateral raise at 7.5 kg for 12 and the reverse pec deck at 50 kg for 12: seated dumbbell shoulder press, one set at 22.5 kg then 25 kg for 8 or more (you got 10 on every work set at 22.5 kg on 12 October; if there are no 25 kg dumbbells, stay at 22.5 and log it), the smith bench in the chest-press slot at 75 kg, aiming for 10, and skullcrushers in the overhead triceps slot at 12.5 kg, aiming for 10 on all three (12 October went 10, 9, 9) (not the 115 lb the Singapore cable used).

Still missing: no bodyweight since 23 August (207 lb). The assessment week starts 2 November; a morning weigh-in this week would help. The show, 1 March, is 129 days away.

block.why: Nothing new has been logged since Legs A on 14 October, nine days ago, so this review repeats 22 October's (itself a repeat of 16 to 21 October) and every number stands unchanged: no new data means no new numbers, so nothing is re-derived. Last week, 12 to 18 October, logged three of six sessions (Push B, Pull B, Legs A), and 15 to 22 October have no log. Nine days off is a break, not a layoff, and no reason to cut weight; if the break runs past 25 October, the build block ends here and the deload week (26 October to 1 November) is the way back in at lighter loads, which suits a return after a week off; but Legs B itself was last trained on 5 October at Singapore, 18 days ago, so its machine lifts (leg press, leg curl, calf press) are first visits at Chennai and their cards say the first set finds the weight. Today is the fifth day of week 4 of 4 of the third build block, which ends 25 October; the deload runs 26 October to 1 November, assessment 2 to 8 November, prep from 9 November; the show is 129 days out. The latest night is still Legs A at Chennai on 14 October, 11 of 20 sets, with the leg press and leg curl slots done as a smith squat and a kettlebell hip thrust and four slots (leg extension, adductor, abductor, calf press) not logged. Three gyms in three weeks (Warsaw, Singapore, Chennai) means most lifts are re-finding a machine, so the block's progress shows where a gym repeats: Chennai's pull and push days were done in full or nearly (all 24 prescribed sets on 12 October, 26 logged with two extra sets, and 18 of 20 on 13 October) and leg days are where sets go missing. The program is not changed today: version 3 was written on 13 October, its Legs B squat and Push A lateral raise have not been run yet, and one partial leg night at a gym whose equipment is not known is not a reason to restructure. Whether Chennai has a leg press, leg curl, leg extension and hip machines is asked in the brief; if not, the program is fitted to the gym. Tonight is steered to Legs B, the session longest untrained (5 October), which also puts the six-day order back in sequence. Next boundary is the 26 October deload, where the nine muscles above their ceiling on paper are re-sized and calves, the deadlift, the hanging leg raise and the leg extension are decided (all dated in deferred).

chest.why: Nineteen a week on paper, one over the ceiling of 18, by the count that gives helper muscles half a set (dips and both crossovers included); the direct pressing is incline 4 and chest press 3 and 3. No chest work has been logged since Push B at Chennai on 12 October (all 24 prescribed sets done; smith bench 75 kg for 8, 8 in the chest-press slot), so nothing has moved. Held to the 26 October deload, where it is re-sized with the other over-ceiling muscles.

front-delts.why: Eighteen and a half on paper against a ceiling of 10, of which 11 are direct (incline press 4, shoulder press 3 on Push A and 4 on Push B); the rest is half credit from the chest press, crossovers and dips. The pressing is moving: 22.5 kg for 10, 10, 10 on the seated press at Chennai on 12 October. No push session since, so no new reading. Re-sized at the 26 October deload.

side-delts.why: Program v2 on 13 October put a lateral raise on Push A (3 sets) and set Push B to 3, so 9.5 a week is planned against a floor of 8; the 4.1 done average is the old program, when Push B was the only side-delt day. The Push A raise has not been run yet (Push A last ran 6 October). Hold and read it after the next Push A.

rear-delts.why: Ten direct sets a week (reverse pec deck 3 and 3, face pulls 2 and 2) and 15.5 on paper with row and pulldown helpers, over the ceiling of 12 by that count. Face pulls were the slot skipped at Chennai on 13 October; reverse pec deck 50 kg for 11, 11, 11 there on 12 October. Re-sized at the deload with the other helper-heavy muscles.

lats.why: Seventeen planned, inside 10 to 18. Wide pulldown 100 for 10, 10, 10 at Singapore on 8 October (top of range); close pulldown 130 for 8, 8 and straight-arm 110 for 12 at Chennai on 13 October. Nothing logged for lats since 13 October. Done 9 a week over four weeks, under the floor of 10, because sessions were missed (three of six logged 12 to 18 October, none since), not because the plan is short: seventeen planned is enough when the pull days are trained. Held; the deload on 26 October re-reads it.

upper-back.why: Eighteen on paper against a ceiling of 16, of which eight are direct rows. The smith row held 65 kg for 9, 9 at Chennai on 13 October; seated row 105, 115, 115 for 12 at Singapore on 8 October. No new pull session; re-sized at the deload.

traps.why: Eight and a half planned, inside 4 to 10. Shrug slot done as a reverse smith shrug at Chennai on 13 October, 55 kg for 16, 17, 18, inside the 12-to-20 range. Hold until 20 lands. Done 3.5 a week over four weeks, under the floor of 4, because sessions were missed (three of six logged 12 to 18 October, none since), not because the plan is short.

lower-back.why: Five and a half on paper from the deadlift, RDL and bent-over row; no direct slot and none needed. The 14 October Legs A at Chennai loaded it lightly through the smith squat. No complaint logged.

biceps.why: Eleven direct sets, eighteen on paper with row and pulldown helpers, over the ceiling of 14 by that count. Curls are moving: reverse curl 77, 88, 99 for 15, 13, 12 and incline curl 30 for 9 at Chennai on 13 October. No new pull session; re-sized at the deload.

triceps.why: Twenty-one on paper against a ceiling of 14; eleven direct (overhead extension 3 and 3, dips 3, reverse-grip pushdown 2) after the 13 October cut, the other ten are press helper credit. Skullcrushers 12.5 kg for 10, 9, 9 and pushdown 55 kg for 11, 12 at Chennai on 12 October. The cut has not been run yet; re-read at the 26 October deload.

forearms.why: Six direct sets (reverse and hammer curls), eleven on paper with shrug and curl helpers, over the ceiling of 8 by that count. Reverse curl 99 for 12 on 13 October. Re-sized at the deload.

quads.why: Eleven and a half planned against a floor of 10 since the smith squat went onto Legs B on 13 October; 4.6 done a week over four weeks. On 14 October at Chennai the quads got 5 sets: the leg-press slot was done as a smith squat, 45 kg for 5, 7, 8, plus split squats at 20 lb for 8 and 10, and the leg extension was not logged. Tonight is Legs B, whose smith squat has not been run yet; quads are the muscle to read after it.

hamstrings.why: Eighteen and a half on paper, over the ceiling of 14, yet 7.9 done a week on average because leg days are the ones cut short or skipped. On 14 October the leg-curl slot was done as a kettlebell hip thrust (20 kg for 8, 12, 12), which is a glute lift, so last week (12 to 18 October) had no direct hamstring work. Tonight's Legs B carries the RDL and the leg curl. Not cutting while attendance is the problem; re-sized at the 26 October deload. The weekly count above credits the 14 October hip thrust as a leg curl (3 sets); without it the 4-week average is about 7.1, not 7.9.

glutes.why: Seventeen and a half on paper, over 14, because every hinge, squat and press credits them; 7 done a week on average. The 14 October kettlebell hip thrust in the leg-curl slot is glute work, not hamstring work. Re-sized at the deload, not cut on arithmetic alone. The weekly count credits the 14 October hip thrust to the leg curl, so glutes are a little understated and hamstrings a little overstated.

adductors.why: Six planned (2 direct on Legs A plus helper credit), at the ceiling of 6 since the Legs B pair came off on 13 October. The adductor machine was not logged at Chennai on 14 October, so the direct work last week (12 to 18 October) was zero; the question of whether that gym has the machine is in the brief.

abductors.why: Two planned, exactly the floor, all on Legs A. Not logged at Chennai on 14 October; 60 for 15, 15 at Singapore on 5 October. If Chennai has no abductor machine this muscle gets nothing until he moves on; that is in the brief as a question.

calves.why: Nine planned against a floor of 6, but 4.1 done a week over four weeks, under the floor in practice: the calf press was skipped at Chennai on 14 October (not logged), and on Legs B it is the last slot by his own choice on 13 October (abs first). Read again after tonight; if Chennai cannot load it, the deload on 26 October is where calves get a slot that fits the gym. The 4.1 includes half-credit from the 14 October hip thrust counted as a leg curl; calves actually got no sets that week, so the true average is about 3.7.

abs.why: Eight planned (cable crunch 3 and 3, hanging leg raise 2), 3.3 done a week on average, under the floor of 4, because sessions were missed (three of six logged 12 to 18 October, none since), not because the plan is short. On 14 October the crunch was logged 55 for 12 then 60 for 10, 10, but all three sets were entered on the evening of 15 October within two seconds of each other, so they are remembered numbers and nothing is raised off them. Tonight both ab slots sit before the calf press, as he asked.

smith-incline-press.why: Last read at Singapore on 6 October as an incline barbell, 70 kg for 8 then 75 kg for 6, 6, 6; 165 for 6 at the old gym on 19 September. Not trained since. At Chennai the first visit sets the number.

machine-chest-press.why: Four gyms in four weeks: 160 for 12 on 19 September, 160, 165, 165 for 10 at Warsaw on 30 September (the best reading this block), 130 for 10 at Singapore on 6 October, and a smith bench at Chennai, 70 kg for 8 then 75 kg for 8, 8 on 12 October. Progress on whichever machine he sees twice: at Chennai, 75 kg earns 10 before it moves.

cable-crossover-low-high.why: 10 for 15, 15, 15 at Singapore on 6 October, top of the range. Up a plate next time on that stack; at Chennai the first set finds the weight.

db-shoulder-press.why: Push B at Chennai on 12 October, seated: 18 kg for 10, then 22.5 kg for 10, 10, 10, the top of 8 to 10, so 25 kg next Push B. Push A asks 10 to 12 and 20 kg went 8, 8, 8 at Singapore on 6 October, so Push A holds and earns 10.

machine-lateral-raise.why: On Push A since 13 October, 3 sets of 12 to 15 after the shoulder press; Push A has not run since. If the gym has no lateral raise machine, the cable or dumbbell raise is the same slot, marked on the card; the dumbbell raise on Push B is held at 7.5 kg, asking 12 on all three after 10, 10, 10 on 12 October.

reverse-pec-deck.why: 50 kg for 11, 11, 11 at Chennai on 12 October; 95 for 12s at Singapore on 6 October. Two machines. Earn 12 on all three at 50 kg, then up.

overhead-cable-triceps.why: Done as skullcrushers at Chennai on 12 October, 12.5 kg for 10, 9, 9; 100, 115, 110 for 12 at Singapore on 6 October on the cable. A new movement sets its own number on the first visit; hold 12.5 kg and earn 10 on all three.

deadlift.why: 265 for 5 in August, 255 for 4, 4 on 10 September, 235 for 4, 245 for 5 and 255 for 3, 3 on 20 September ("Too early in morning"), 95 kg for 5, 5 at Warsaw on 27 September, 225 for 6, 4, 4, 4 at Singapore on 8 October ("Sick today"); those four rows were entered within 17 seconds, so they are recalled, not timed. Hold 225 lb next Pull A for 5 on every set, or 100 kg (about 220 lb) if the plates are in kilos, since Warsaw's 95 kg went 5, 5 on 27 September; only one Pull A fits before the deload, and if it does not get 5 on every set the lift rotates at the deload (dated in deferred).

lat-pulldown-wide.why: 100 for 10, 10, 10 at Singapore on 8 October, top of the range. Up one plate next time on the same stack; at Chennai, find it on the first set.

seated-cable-row-wide.why: 105, 115, 115 for 12 at Singapore on 8 October, three of the four sets asked, top of the range. That was the Singapore stack; at Chennai the first set finds the weight, and all four sets are asked.

The last dumbbell nights were 12.5 kg (about 27.5 lb) for 10 on 20 September and 10 kg for 8 at Warsaw on 27 September. Pull A has not been done at Chennai, so the first set finds the weight there: if it is a barbell again, hold 65 lb (about 30 kg) and earn 10; if it is dumbbells, start at 12.5 kg and earn 10.

leg-curl.why: 120 lb for 10, 10, 11 at Singapore on 5 October; 145 lb for 12s at Warsaw on 28 September; different machines. Tonight: 120 lb (about 54 kg) for 10 to 12 if Chennai has a leg curl machine; a dumbbell leg curl lying face down on a bench if it does not.

The old stall flag is a gym-change artefact; no Legs A fits before the deload now (Legs A would fall on 26 October, the first deload day), so at the deload it is swapped for a quad lift the gym has unless he says Chennai has a leg extension (dated in deferred).

hip-abductor.why: Not logged at Chennai on 14 October; 60 for 15, 15 at Singapore on 5 October, 110 for 15 at Warsaw on 28 September. Next Legs A finds it on the first set, if the gym has one.

standing-calf-raise.why: 290 lb for 15, 290 lb for 12, then 270 lb for 14 at Singapore on 5 October; 280 lb for 12s at Warsaw on 28 September. Not logged at Chennai on 14 October. Tonight: 270 lb (about 122 kg) to find the machine, then 290 lb (about 132 kg) for 12s; if the gym has no leg press or calf machine, any standing calf raise, logged as what it was.

cable-crunch.why: 55 for 12, 12, 12 at Singapore on 5 October. At Chennai on 14 October: 55 for 12, then 60 for 10 and 10, but all three were entered on the evening of 15 October within two seconds, so they are remembered numbers. 55 lb is 25 kg, so the first set may be a real kilo reading; 60 lb is 27.2 kg, which is not a kilo step, so the last two may be remembered from the old card. The weight is held because of how the sets were entered, not because of the arithmetic. Tonight the first set finds the stack (about 25 kg, then 27.5 kg if it is in kilos).

assisted-dips.why: Bench dips 17, 17, 17, 17 at Chennai on 12 October, the only night of this movement (the Warsaw "Dips" were a different movement), so there is no trend yet. Three sets since 13 October. Hold at bodyweight for 17 on all three; add reps toward 20 once 17 repeats.

db-lateral-raise.why: 10 lb for 15 to warm up, then 7.5 kg for 10, 10, 10 at Chennai on 12 October, under the 12-rep floor. Three sets since 13 October. Hold 7.5 kg and earn 12.

cable-crossover-high-low.why: 35 kg for 15, then 45 kg for 15 and 14 at Chennai on 12 October. One set at 45 short of 15, so hold 45 and get 15 on both.

reverse-grip-pushdown.why: 55 kg for 11, 12 at Chennai on 12 October against a range of 12 to 15: the first set was under the floor. Hold 55 kg: 12 on both sets next, then build to 15 on both before it moves.

smith-bent-over-row.why: 65 kg for 9, 9 at Chennai on 13 October after 55 and 60 kg for 10; 65 kg for 9, 8, 7 at Singapore on 3 October. Two machines, and Chennai held 9 where Singapore fell to 7. Hold 65 kg and earn 10 on both top sets. No Pull B fits before the deload now, so there is no further test: the 26 October deload swaps it for a chest-supported or cable row on these two nights (dated in deferred).

lat-pulldown-close.why: 115 then 130 for 8, 8 at Chennai on 13 October, the bottom of 8 to 10. Hold 130 and earn 10.

straight-arm-pulldown.why: 77, 99, 110 for 12s at Chennai on 13 October, top of the range. Next Pull B at Chennai starts at 110 and the top set goes up.

db-shrug.why: Reverse smith shrug at Chennai on 13 October, 55 kg for 16, 17, 18, inside 12 to 20. Hold 55 kg until 20 lands on all three.

incline-db-curl.why: 25 for 10 then 30 for 9 at Chennai on 13 October. Hold 30 and earn 10 on both.

cable-reverse-curl.why: 77, 88, 99 for 15, 13, 12 at Chennai on 13 October, top of the range on every set. Start at 99 next time.

smith-rdl.why: 155, 175, 185 for 8 at Singapore on 5 October; 135, 165, 185 for 8 on 17 September; 205 for 9 in August. The top set has sat at 185 for 8 on two nights. Tonight is the first RDL on the Chennai smith machine, which is labelled in kg and is a different machine, so nothing from Singapore carries over 1:1: one ramp set at 70 kg, then two working sets at 80 kg aiming for 10 (80 kg is lighter than the 185 lb, about 84 kg, he has been stuck at for 8), which keeps the 13 October shape (two of three sets are work). If 80 goes 10 on both, 85 next time. Rotation decided at the 26 October deload (dated in deferred).

smith-squat.why: On Legs B since 13 October and not yet run in this slot. The same movement was done on the same Chennai smith machine on 14 October in the leg-press slot: 45 kg for 5, 7, 8. On 14 October it opened the session; tonight it follows three RDL sets, so one set at 40 kg for 8, then 45 kg aiming for 8 on both sets, the bottom of the 8 to 10 range and what the last set reached that night (the slot note: find the working weight on the second set). leg-press-high.why: 150, 170, 190 lb for 10s at Singapore on 5 October; 140 lb for 10s at Warsaw on 24 September and 180 lb for 12 at the home gym on 16 August. Three machines, so no trend is read across them. No leg press logged at Chennai yet (on 14 October the feet-low slot was done as a smith squat). findings.finding: The smith row deferred note offered an escape ("unless a Pull B logged before then reaches 10") that cannot happen, since no Pull B fits before the deload, and called the lift stalled while its own verdict said Chennai held 9 where Singapore fell to 7 on a different machine.
findings.why: Removed the impossible condition and stated the decision plainly: neither night reached 10 at 65 kg, no further test fits, so the deload swaps it for a chest-supported or cable row started light. Lift verdict and brief now say the same.
